name: Exage Motion handlebar-mounted flipper shifter pair
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed weight for the complete left/right SL-A250 six-speed handlebar-mounted SIS/friction lever pair. Shimano SI-R-40 explicitly specifies 169 g per pair; no individual-side figures are doubled.
